cost_to_income_ratio.formula: (Cost of sales + Marketing and selling expenses + General and administrative expenses + Other operating income and expenses) / Revenue
cost_to_income_ratio.reason: A cost-to-income ratio of 0.7771 indicates that for every euro of revenue, LVMH incurs about 77.71 cents in operating costs.

quick_ratio.formula: (Cash and cash equivalents + Trade accounts receivable + Income taxes (Current asset)) / Current liabilities

debt_to_equity_ratio.formula: (Long-term borrowings + Short-term borrowings + Non-current lease liabilities + Current lease liabilities) / (Equity, Group share + Minority interests)

debt_to_assets_ratio.formula: (Long-term borrowings + Short-term borrowings + Non-current lease liabilities + Current lease liabilities) / Total assets

debt_to_capital_ratio.formula: (Long-term borrowings + Short-term borrowings + Non-current lease liabilities + Current lease liabilities) / (Equity, Group share + Minority interests + Long-term borrowings + Short-term borrowings + Non-current lease liabilities + Current lease liabilities)
